name: @polymech/pm-acl
description: Standalone RBAC and vfs-settings loader. Consumed by vfs.cpp and Tanit; not linked into them by default.

scripts.build:cpp: npm run configure && node ../../scripts/cmake.mjs --build --preset dev --target pm-acl
scripts.build:cpp:release: npm run configure:release && node ../../scripts/cmake.mjs --build --preset release --target pm-acl
